title: Netatmo Weather Module Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil-moisture/greenhouse sensors, aquarium controllers (`aquarium:sensor`).
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=netatmo:weather
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(module_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Netatmo weather module events land each day and how many distinct module values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Netatmo weather module records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct module values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It quietly how much Netatmo weather module activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
